newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: South Korea's KEPCO tenders to buy November LSWR.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's KEPCO tenders to buy November LSWR.

text.p: South Korea's Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) has issued a tender to buy low sulphur waxy residue (LSWR) for delivery in November, industry sources said on Wednesday.
The tender seeks 400,000 barrels of LSWR for delivery to Inchon between November 5 and 9 on a cost-and-freight basis.
The tender closes October 7 and is valid for three days.
In its last tender, KEPCO bought 200,000 barrels of LSWR from refiner Yukong Ltd at $2.555 per barrel over published quotes on a c-and-f basis for July 15-19 delivery to Ulsan.
